text: あたしが　せかい　じゅうから　あつめた　ポケモン　みてー！

structure.jp: あたしが　せかい　じゅうから　あつめた
structure.en: that I collected from all over the world

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: あたしが　せかい　じゅうから　あつめた　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb put right before a thing tells you which thing it is. あたしが　せかい　じゅうから　あつめた　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon I collected from all over the world'.

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in て on its own is a casual way to ask someone to do it; the long sound is just her drawing it out. みてー = 'look!'.

patterns.name: 〜じゅう
patterns.explanation: じゅう after a place means all through that place. せかい　じゅう = 'all over the world'.
